text_en:
At seven in the morning we reached Hannibal, Missouri, where my boyhood
was spent.
text_zh: 早上七点，我们抵达密苏里州汉尼拔，我的童年就是在那里度过的。

text_en:
Forty of the wounded were placed upon pallets on the floor of a great
public hall, and among these was Henry. There the ladies of Memphis
came every day, with flowers, fruits, and dainties and delicacies of
all kinds, and there they remained and nursed the wounded.
text_zh: 四十名伤员被安置在一座大礼堂地板上的铺位上，亨利也在其中。孟菲斯的女士们每天带来鲜花、水果和各种佳肴，留在这里护理伤员。

location_zh: 第 50 章《最初的雅各布斯》
text_en:
In 1832 steamer “Hudson” made the run from White River to Helena, a
distance of seventy-five miles, in twelve hours.
text_zh: 1832年，哈德逊号汽船从白河航行至海伦娜，七十五英里的航程用了十二小时。

text_en:
WE reached St. Paul, at the head of navigation of the Mississippi, and
there our voyage of two thousand miles from New Orleans ended.
text_zh: 我们到达密西西比河航运的终点圣保罗，从新奥尔良出发的两千英里航程至此结束。

text_en:
Then we have Muscatine, ten thousand; Winona, ten thousand;
Moline, ten thousand; Rock Island, twelve thousand; La Crosse, twelve
thousand; Burlington, twenty-five thousand; Dubuque, twenty-five
thousand; Davenport, thirty thousand; St. Paul, fifty-eight thousand,
Minneapolis, sixty thousand and upward.
text_zh: 接下来，马斯卡廷有一万人，威诺纳一万人；莫林一万人，罗克艾兰一万二千人，拉克罗斯一万二千人；伯灵顿两万五千人，迪比克两万五千人；达文波特三万人，圣保罗五万八千人，明尼阿波利斯六万人以上。

text_en:
We move up the river--always through enchanting scenery, there being no
other kind on the Upper Mississippi--and pass Moline, a center of vast
manufacturing industries; and Clinton and Lyons, great lumber centers;
and presently reach Dubuque, which is situated in a rich mineral region.
The lead mines are very productive, and of wide extent.
text_zh: 我们溯河而上，沿途始终是迷人的风景——密西西比河上游处处如此——经过工业重镇莫林，又经过木材业重镇克林顿与莱昂斯，不久便到达坐落在富矿地区的迪比克。这里的铅矿产量很高，分布也很广。

location_zh: 第 17 章《河道裁弯与斯蒂芬》
text_en:
Therefore, the Mississippi between Cairo and New Orleans was twelve
hundred and fifteen miles long one hundred and seventy-six years ago.
text_zh: 因此，一百七十六年前，开罗与新奥尔良之间的密西西比河长一千二百一十五英里。

location: Chapter 22, The Grass Withereth—the Flower Fadeth
location_zh: 第 22 章《草必枯干，花必凋残》
text_en:
It contained various
refreshing items of home intelligence, with which our reader is fully
acquainted: stated how Aunt Chloe had been hired out to a confectioner
in Louisville, where her skill in the pastry line was gaining wonderful
sums of money, all of which, Tom was informed, was to be laid up to go
to make up the sum of his redemption money; Mose and Pete were
thriving, and the baby was trotting all about the house, under the care
of Sally and the family generally.
text_zh: 信中有许多令人欣慰的家乡消息，这些读者已经知道：克洛伊大娘受雇于路易斯维尔的一位糖果糕点商，她的糕点手艺赚来了可观的收入，汤姆得知这些钱都将存起来为他赎身；摩西与皮特长得很好，小宝宝也已能在屋里走动，由萨莉和家里人照料。

location: Chapter 1, The Magnet Attracting: A Waif Amid Forces
location_zh: 第 1 章《磁石的吸引：漂泊的孤女》
text_en:
When Caroline Meeber boarded the afternoon train for Chicago, her total
outfit consisted of a small trunk, a cheap imitation alligator-skin
satchel, a small lunch in a paper box, and a yellow leather snap purse,
containing her ticket, a scrap of paper with her sister’s address in
Van Buren Street, and four dollars in money. It was in August, 1889.
text_zh: 卡罗琳·米伯登上开往芝加哥的午后火车时，全部行李只有一只小箱子、一个便宜的仿鳄鱼皮手提包、一份纸盒装午餐，以及一个黄色皮革搭扣钱包。钱包里装着车票、一张写有姐姐在范布伦街住址的纸条和四美元。那是1889年八月。

location: Chapter 32, The Feast of Belshazzar: A Seer to Translate
location_zh: 第 32 章《伯沙撒的盛宴：解读的先知》
text_en:
“Yes; I am just on here from Indianapolis for a week or so,” said young
Ames, seating himself on the edge of a chair to wait while Mrs. Vance
completed the last touches of her toilet.
text_zh: “是的，我从印第安纳波利斯来这里待一周左右，”年轻的艾姆斯说。他坐在椅子边上，等万斯太太完成最后的梳妆。

text_en: Laura visits Pepin with her family, sees the lake and explores the unfamiliar sights of the town.
text_zh: 劳拉与家人来到佩平，看见湖泊，探索镇上陌生的新鲜景象。

text_en: In Maycomb, Scout and Jem watch Atticus defend Tom Robinson and confront the town’s racial prejudice.
text_zh: 在梅科姆，斯库特和杰姆旁听阿蒂克斯为汤姆·鲁滨逊辩护，面对镇上的种族偏见。

text_en: In rural Georgia, Celie writes to God about the abuse and isolation she experiences within her family.
text_zh: 在佐治亚乡村，西莉写信向上帝诉说自己在家庭中遭受的虐待与孤独。

text_en: In Jefferson, Dilsey takes Benjy to an Easter church service as the Compson family continues to unravel.
text_zh: 在杰斐逊，迪尔西带班吉参加复活节礼拜，而康普生一家仍在走向瓦解。

location_zh: 珍妮与乔·斯塔克斯的婚姻
text_en: In Eatonville, Joe Starks builds his standing through his store and public role, while Janie finds her freedom increasingly restricted.
text_zh: 在伊顿维尔，乔·斯塔克斯通过商店和公共职务建立威望，珍妮却感到自己的自由日益受限。

text_en: Janie leaves Eatonville and travels to Jacksonville to marry Tea Cake, beginning a different life after Joe’s death.
text_zh: 乔去世后，珍妮离开伊顿维尔，前往杰克逊维尔与茶点结婚，开始另一种生活。

text_en: Nick steps off the train at Seney and finds that fire has destroyed the town before he heads into the countryside.
text_zh: 尼克在塞尼下火车，发现城镇已被大火毁坏，随后走向郊野。

text_en: Nick fishes alone and concentrates on the practical details of the river and his tackle; the Fox River supplied the story’s real-world fishing landscape.
text_zh: 尼克独自垂钓，专注于河流与钓具的具体细节；福克斯河为这个故事提供了现实中的垂钓环境。

text_en: After Jake Spoon kills a man in Fort Smith and flees, Sheriff July Johnson sets out to find him.
text_zh: 杰克·斯普恩在史密斯堡杀人后逃走，警长朱莱·约翰逊出发追捕他。

text_en: Call brings Gus’s body back to Texas and buries him near San Antonio, fulfilling his friend’s final request.
text_zh: 考尔将格斯的遗体带回得克萨斯，安葬在圣安东尼奥附近，完成朋友最后的嘱托。
